chunks: If you have completed the prayer, remember Allah while standing, sitting, or lying on your sides; and when you are secure, perform the prayer properly; indeed, prayer has been prescribed for the believers at fixed times.
ai.seo_question: How should Muslims perform prayer during times of fear or battle according to the Quran?
ai.summary: This verse, known as the 'Verse of Fear' (Ayat al-Khauf), establishes the legal principle of *salat al-khauf*, permitting abbreviated prayer postures during combat or danger. Shia jurisprudence emphasizes that this concession is temporary, requiring believers to resume the complete, ritualized prayer (*salat al-tamam*) once the threat of fear subsides, thereby balancing spiritual duty with practical necessity.
